# _attic manifest

Moved 2026-10-06. Nothing here was deleted or edited; each file sits at
`apps/Research-Acquisition/_attic/<original path>`, so `git mv` it back to restore.

Rule: everything in `apps/Research-Acquisition/` that `ytgrab.py` and the watch plugin
(`youtube-transcript-ytdlp/watch_downloader/`) do not need was moved here.
Kept in place: ytgrab.py, the modules it imports, its launchers, and the watch plugin.

**33623 files moved**, in 22 groups.

| Group | Files | Why it moved |
|---|---|---|
| `(root files)` | 15 | Research-Acquisition root note, launcher or stylesheet; not used by ytgrab.py or the watch plugin. |
| `.venv-duke-axioms/` | 12683 | A committed Python virtual environment (site-packages). Not used by ytgrab.py or the watch plugin. |
| `80 Arguments/` | 2 | Debate-map search output. Not used by ytgrab.py or the watch plugin. |
| `API_ALL/` | 2539 | API station pipelines (CKG baseline, API_HOME stations, crawl4ai, paper grader). Not run by ytgrab.py or the watch plugin. The baseline summary task from API_ALL/01_YOUTUBE/deepseek-home was copied verbatim into the hub's prompts/Y_youtube/. |
| `API_ALL/crawl4ai/` | 7959 | crawl4ai crawler. Not used by ytgrab.py or the watch plugin. Candidate to restore when screen 3 (Acquisition) wraps a crawler. |
| `Deep-Research-Hub/` | 1 | An old one-file README copy of this repo. |
| `RECOVERED_CLOUDFLARE_DEEPCRAWL_2026-08-31/` | 3 | Recovered HTML of an earlier crawl GUI. |
| `Researcher/` | 1681 | gpt-researcher, provenote and deepdoc research apps. Not used by ytgrab.py or the watch plugin. Candidate to restore for screen 1 or 2. |
| `Rust-Search-/` | 11 | tpsearch, a Rust markdown search engine. Not used by ytgrab.py or the watch plugin. Candidate to restore for screen 4 (Search Engine). |
| `ZZZ_Archive/` | 888 | Already archived by its owner (gpt-researcher superseded 2026-08-24). |
| `gptr-mcp/` | 15 | GPT Researcher MCP server. Not used by ytgrab.py or the watch plugin. |
| `link-research-engine/` | 41 | Link ingestion and source research. Not used by ytgrab.py or the watch plugin. Candidate to restore for screen 3 (Acquisition, Links/Crawl). |
| `open-science/` | 5871 | AIPOCH Open-Science research workbench. Not used by ytgrab.py or the watch plugin. |
| `theophysics-link-harvester/` | 45 | Link harvester. Not used by ytgrab.py or the watch plugin. Candidate to restore for screen 3 (Acquisition). |
| `trafilatura/` | 1169 | trafilatura HTML-to-text extractor (vendored). Not used by ytgrab.py or the watch plugin. Candidate to restore for screen 3 (Scrape). |
| `youtube-research-tool/` | 28 | The other downloader: yt_scrape.py and its .txt format with TITLE:/URL: headers, retired in favour of ytgrab.py markdown. |
| `youtube-scraper/` | 50 | An older YouTube transcript scraper (ytb_scraper, easy_scrape, Bible-contradiction scrapers). Superseded by ytgrab.py. |
| `youtube-transcript-ytdlp/` | 7 | The other downloader: scraper.py (yt-dlp, hard-coded channel list, .srt output) and its transcript relay. Superseded by ytgrab.py. Its watch_downloader/ stays in place. |
| `youtubepro/` | 137 | YouTube Pro web client. Not used by ytgrab.py or the watch plugin. |
| `yt-bulk-subtitles-downloader/` | 448 | AI-HUB v2 AutoHotkey desktop system and bulk subtitle downloader. Not used by ytgrab.py or the watch plugin. |
| `yt-transcript-downloader/` | 28 | yt-transcript-downloader tool that ytgrab.py does not import or launch (ytbsd wizard menus, SRT conversion, polish, split, score, deep-analyze, AHK GUI, prompts). |
| `yt-transcript-downloader/Python Clean Library/` | 2 | Clean Library launcher or helper that readable_prose_converter.py does not import. |
